_meta.method: All facts from pages fetched on 2026-10-01 (WebSearch/WebFetch); nothing from model memory. Official Google pages preferred; GSMArena / press used for spec-sheet detail not on Google pages. Conflicts recorded in 'conflicts' fields.
caveats: store.google.com spec/price pages render prices client-side and could not be read directly; US per-tier prices come from Android Authority and GSMArena, India prices from Beebom (citing Google Store India).
Google Store US phones page (store.google.com/us/category/phones) also lists Pixel 10a; no Pixel 11a was found in any source. Pixel 10a not researched further.

launch.event: Made by Google 2026 (in-person, New York, 6 PM ET; hosted by Trevor Noah per Engadget live blog)

models.name: Pixel 11
models.display: 6.3" OLED ('Actua'), 1080x2424, 60-120Hz, HDR10+, 2000 nits HBM / 3000 nits peak, Gorilla Glass Victus 2
models.charging: 30W wired (55% in 30 min per GSMArena); 25W Qi2.2 magnetic wireless (Pixelsnap)

cameras.telephoto: 10.8MP f/3.1 5x optical, up to 30x Super Res Zoom

notable_new_features: Gemini Intelligence multistep tasks across 40+ apps
conflicts: India start price: Beebom/91mobiles Rs 89,999 vs GSMArena listing Rs 104,999 (GSMArena figure matches the 512GB variant).
Engadget says a telephoto lens was 'added to base model'; Wikipedia's Pixel 10 page shows the Pixel 10 already had a 10.8MP 5x telephoto, so treat Engadget's claim as wrong.

whats_new_vs_pixel_10.claim: Tensor G6: 50% more TPU compute, ~25% faster web browsing, 15% faster app launches vs Tensor G5; Titan M3 security chip with post-quantum cryptography
Tensor G6 process node is disputed: Android Central says 2nm, GSMArena lists 3nm
Pro/Pro XL displays have 2x+ the scratch resistance of Pixel 10; up to 3600 nits
Base storage rises from 128GB to 256GB on all three slab phones; US prices up accordingly ($899 / $1,099 / $1,299)
Pixel 11 Pro/Pro XL now start at 12GB RAM instead of 16GB
Qi2.2 25W wireless charging is new to Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro (Pixel 10 had 15W Qi2 per Wikipedia)
Pixel 11 Pro XL wired charging is 45W
Pro telephoto 48MP with 30% more light sensitivity; Instant Night Sight captures up to 4.5x faster (Pro/Pro XL)
Pixel 11 main camera 48MP with 56% more light sensitivity
Pro battery rating goes from 24 to 30+ hours
HiLight colored rear LED notifications on Pixel 11 Pro, Pro XL and Pro Fold
Pixel 11 Pro Fold ~10% lighter, ~1mm thinner, 3x more durable, gearless hinge, displays 20% brighter, wireless charging 20% faster than Pixel 10 Pro Fold
New software: Magic Capture, Camera Looks, Creator Suite, Rambler, Sign-to-Text, Live Translate dubbing, Gemini Intelligence across 40+ apps
